deployment_notes: run the local RAG service beside the shared infrastructure layer so retrieval, embeddings, and generation remain private and reproducible

ingestion.boundary_notes: keep ingestion local, write only to repository-backed storage and the private vector store, and avoid external publication during indexing
ingestion.retry_notes: retry parse and embedding steps for transient failures; fail fast on invalid source documents

steps.name: discover
steps.purpose: find eligible local source files and documents

steps.name: parse
steps.purpose: extract text and structure from source files

steps.name: chunk
steps.purpose: split content into manageable retrieval chunks

steps.name: embed
steps.purpose: send chunks to the embedding service

steps.name: index
steps.purpose: persist vectors and metadata to the vector database

steps.name: verify
steps.purpose: check the indexed documents and record ingestion status

storage_plan.restore: restore the vector store before resuming retrieval or answer generation
storage_plan.retention: keep indexed vectors, metadata, and embedding state on durable storage
